messages: maya: Quick follow-up on bit-fidelity contracts and explainability — can we decide whether the runtime should emit a human-readable `fidelity_reason` when it switches precision (fp8/int8/4bit)?
raj: My read: yes, but light. We need a structured tag for ops + an opaque human string for SREs. Don't want to leak internal heuristics to customers.
olivia: Agreed on structured tag. We should standardize keys: `reason_code`, `score_delta`, `profile_id`. Example: `reason_code=degradation_threshold`, `score_delta=0.12`.
maya: That matches what I sketched. Tradeoffs: extra telemetry & token cost vs faster incident triage.
sam: From API/product POV we also want a short explanation in admin console (non-PII). So something like `fidelity_explainable: "short phrase"` that can be surfaced in UI.
june: Ops concern: emitting more fields increases metrics cardinality. Can we restrict `reason_code` to an enum and keep `profile_id` optional? Also add sampling for debug payloads.
raj: Enum + sampling sounds good. Runtime can emit full debug payload to internal logs (sampled 1/1000) and minimal events to observability pipeline.
maya: Quick proto for minimal event (for the contract):
{ "event":"fidelity_change", "model":"rw-1-large", "reason_code":"degradation_threshold", "score_delta":"0.12", "new_bitwidth":"int8" }
olivia: And add `explainable_label` for UI: one of `{"quality_loss","cost_optimization","capacity_fallback"}`. Short, non-technical.
sam: Important: prevent customer-facing docs from exposing exact thresholds (security/abuse surface). UI should show label + non-actionable hint.
june: Ops follow-ups: 1) runtime emits minimal event + sampled debug 2) metrics team adds tag `fidelity_lane` 3) we cap high-cardinality fields and route debug traces to JH.
maya: One more question: should profile API allow customers to opt-in to receive `explainable_label` for their tenant? That helps teams debugging but may reveal behavior.
raj: Offer opt-in for tenant-admins with explicit consent and audit log entry. Default: no customer-visible internals.
olivia: Also we should hook this into evaluate/regression tests: when a new quant profile proposes lower-bit path, it must emit expected `score_delta` and a qualitative label.
sam: Action items:
- sam: draft API addition for `fidelity_explainable` + opt-in flow
- raj/runtime: implement enum event + sampled debug emitter
- june/ops: define sampling rate and metric tagging plan
- olivia/ml: update eval harness to assert `score_delta` bounds
maya: Cool. If nobody objects I'll add this to the RFC follow-up doc and open PRs for API + runtime stubs.
raj: :thumbsup:
olivia: :+1:
sam: :rocket:
runtime-bot: Deploy pipeline note — canary for runtime change will be gated behind telemetry sampling flag (flag: `fidelity-debug-sample`)
